name: Big-trade trapped filter
thesis: A big print at an extreme that price then moves against = trapped traders -> confirms a fade (range-mode) or a breakout (orb).
rules: Big trade = single print >= N ES contracts (or top X% of sizes). Trapped = price moves >= m ticks against it within n bars. Allow the host setup's trade only when this shows up.
